name: emotion_valence
description: Determine positive versus negative emotional sentiment from descriptive adjectives, with a matched noun-extraction control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pos=['wonderful','excellent','delightful','fantastic','amazing','pleasant','enjoyable','lovely','superb','brilliant','great','marvelous','satisfying','impressive','beautiful','perfect']
neg=['terrible','awful','horrible','dreadful','disappointing','unpleasant','miserable','disgusting','appalling','bad','atrocious','annoying','frustrating','depressing','poor','horrendous']
nouns=['movie','meal','concert','trip','book','service','show','experience']
cs=[(w,label,n) for label,ws in [('positive',pos),('negative',neg)] for w in ws for n in nouns];random.shuffle(cs)
items=[];control=[]
for w,label,n in cs[:120]:
 sentence=f'The {n} was {w}.'
 items.append({'prompt':f'Classify the sentiment as positive or negative.\nText: {sentence}\nAnswer:','answer':' '+label})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Which noun is being described?\nText: {sentence}\nAnswer:','answer':' '+n})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
